title: Cumulative account signups, 2025
prompt: Show cumulative account signups by month for 2025 — a running total finance can chart.
metricDefinition: cumulative count of accounts signed up, by month, through 2025.
referenceSql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', signed_up_at) AS month, count(*) AS new_accounts FROM accounts WHERE signed_up_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND signed_up_at < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', signed_up_at)) SELECT month, new_accounts, sum(new_accounts) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_accounts FROM monthly ORDER BY month
